theater: 波河下游亞里米嫩城郊

battle.name: 里米尼戰役 (432年)
battle.theater: 波河下游亞里米嫩城郊
battle.brief: 432年夏末，羅馬皇帝君士坦丁二世率帳帳軍沿波河下游北上，在亞里米嫩（今義大利里米尼）城外的平原迎擊越過阿爾卑斯南下的赫魯利、汪達爾與格皮德人聯軍。聯軍以密集長矛陣橫推，羅軍以弩砲齊射壓散其前排，重裝步兵結盾牆推進，騎兵兩翼合圍，終俘其王弗拉基提烏斯父子。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 羅馬帝國方面，當時唯一挺過所有篡位衝擊的合法皇帝君士坦丁二世正全副精力經營西線。羅軍由三個層次組成：以帳帳軍為骨幹的皇帝野戰軍，兵種混合步兵、騎兵與隨軍工匠；從高盧、西西里與北非抽調的援軍，用來填補西線兵力的空缺；以及禁軍大隊與palatinae援助軍構成的近衛兵力。指揮系統由皇帝本人、軍事總監阿斯帕爾、阿林泰奧斯與奧林匹奧斯，以及各邊區守將與後勤官署組成，糧秣靠帝國的穀物稅與北非的海運供應。聯軍方面，主力是赫魯利人，一個在四世紀末迅速興起的東日耳曼部落聯盟，由眾多小部落的武裝鬥士拼成，擅長長矛突刺；與他們並肩的是汪達爾人與格皮德人，以及自多瑙河東岸西遷下來的匈人騎兵骨幹。全軍由赫魯利王弗拉基提烏斯統帥，其子阿吉斯勞斯與另外數名首領各領一翼。這不是一個有中央政權的國家，只是一次在共同掠奪利益下形成的軍事同盟，糧食靠劫掠與臨時徵集維繫，戰利品由首領按功分給各支部。
countriesEn: On the Roman side stood the Roman Empire under Constantius II, the only legitimate emperor who had ridden out every usurpation of the third and fourth centuries without being unseated, and he was now devoting his whole attention to the western front. The Roman army in this campaign was built from three layers: the field army of the comitatenses, mixing infantry, cavalry and attached craftsmen, formed the backbone; reinforcements were drawn in from Gaul, Sicily and North Africa to make up the shortfall on the western frontier; and the near guard was formed by the scholae palatinae together with the auxilia palatinae. The chain of command ran from the emperor himself, through the magistri militum Aspar, Arinthaeus and Olympius, together with the frontier commanders and the logistics offices of the individual provinces, while the grain came from the empire tax in kind and from the sea transport of North Africa. On the other side the main body was the Heruli, an East Germanic tribal confederation that had risen quickly in the late fourth century, assembled from the armed warriors of many small groups and skilled with the thrusting spear; alongside them stood Vandals and Gepids, together with a Hunnic cavalry core that had moved west from the eastern bank of the Danube. The whole host was commanded by the Heruli king Flaccitheus, while his son Argislaus and several other chieftains led their own wings. This was not a state with a central government but a military alliance formed for the sake of common plunder; it subsisted on what it seized and on ad hoc requisition, and the booty was divided among the different contingents according to the service of each leader.
people: 皇帝君士坦丁二世是這場戰役中唯一留下名字的羅馬統帥，他的決策方式直接決定戰果。431 年他在阿根托拉圖姆（今日的斯特拉斯堡）擊敗阿勒曼尼人與法蘭克人，俘獲阿勒曼尼王阿里奧溫德與法蘭克王基利梅爾，把二人押回羅馬公開示眾，這場勝利提供了法理與士氣上的雙重底氣。面對越過阿爾卑斯南下的聯軍，諸將意見分歧：阿斯帕爾主張趁勢追擊、封死各個山口，阿林泰奧斯等人則擔心深入山區會讓羅馬重蹈 378 年阿德里安堡的覆轍，捲入一次無法負擔的遠征。皇帝最後選擇折衷，留一部兵員監視萊茵方向，主力沿波河下游北上，在亞里米嫩外圍的開闊地以羅馬式野戰與聯軍決戰。聯軍方面，弗拉基提烏斯並未死守阿奎萊亞的圍城，而是試圖以全軍傾巢而出的方式取勝；兵敗之後，他與長子阿吉斯勞斯一同被俘，父子二人此後的下落，史料便再無記載。史家佐西莫斯是這一戰的主要記述者，他以羅馬官方的姿態記錄凱旋與立像，細節則多採自軍中傳聞，數字往往偏於誇大。
peopleEn: Emperor Constantius II is the only Roman commander of this campaign whose name has survived, and the way he decided things determined the result. In 431 he had beaten the Alamanni and the Franks at Argentoratum, modern Strasbourg, and had taken the Alamannic king Ariovindus and the Frankish king Gillimer prisoner and dragged them back to Rome for a public display; that victory gave him both a legal and a morale advantage. Faced with the coalition that had crossed the Alps, his generals disagreed: Aspar argued for pressing the advantage and sealing every pass, while Arinthaeus and the others feared that a march deep into the mountains would repeat the disaster of Adrianople in 378 and involve the empire in a pursuit it could not afford. The emperor took a middle course, leaving part of his force to watch the Rhine, and led the main body north along the lower Po to meet the coalition in open country outside Ariminum in the Roman manner. On the coalition side, Flaccitheus did not hug the siege of Aquileia but tried to win everything by throwing the whole host into the field; after the defeat he and his elder son Argislaus were taken prisoner together, and the records say no more of what became of father and son. Zosimus is the principal source for the campaign; he writes in the tone of the Roman establishment, describing the triumph and the statue, but he draws his particulars from camp rumour and his figures tend to run high.
kits: 羅馬弩砲是這場戰役中羅軍最具代表性的裝備。扭力弩砲以兩束扭緊的繩簧儲能，發射時把一具約一臂長、尾端配重的小型弩矢（bolt）擲出，射程在數百步之內，每次裝填只可發射一具，通常架在輕型三腳架或小車平台上，由二至三人的小組操作；較小的一型可由兵手持握發射，較重的一型則是車載的carroballista，射程更遠、穿透力更強。羅軍中負責操作它們的是專設的弩砲隊，每個軍團轄下都有配屬，與石弩同列於軍械序列，攻城與野戰都隨軍攜帶。與這件兵器相配合的，是羅馬步兵的橢圓大盾、鱗甲與環甲、投槍與短劍，騎兵則配刀劍、長矛與弓；營地方面有帳篷營、輜重車隊與可拆卸的橋樑器材。聯軍的裝備要簡陋得多：長矛與大刀為主，盾以木胎包皮者多，鎧甲極少，重甲只在少數首領身上可見，弓則只限於部分步兵。戰後大量聯軍成員被編為帝國的同盟者與屯墾者，這也把他們手中粗劣卻龐大的兵器留在了帝國邊境。
kitsEn: The Roman bolt thrower was the most characteristic piece of equipment on the Roman side in this campaign. The engine stored its energy in two bundles of twisted skeins and threw a single bolt about the length of an outstretched arm, weighted at the tail, to a range of several hundred paces; one shot for one load, it was normally set on a light tripod or on a small cart platform and worked by a crew of two or three. The smaller type could be carried and fired by a soldier on foot, while the heavier type was the cart-mounted carroballista, with a longer reach and more penetrating power. They were worked by dedicated bolt units attached to each legion, standing in the same ordnance list as the stone-throwing engines and carried on campaign whether the army was assaulting a wall or fighting in the open. What went with the engine on the Roman side were the great oval shields of the infantry, scale and ring mail, the pilum and the short sword, while the cavalry carried spade swords, lances and bows; in the camp were tented encampments, baggage trains and the sections of bridging equipment carried in pieces. The coalition kit was far poorer: long spears and broad blades, shields mostly of wood faced with hide, very little armour of any kind, and mail only on a few chiefs, with bows confined to a part of the infantry. After the battle a large part of the coalition was enrolled as federate settlers and colonists, and the crude but enormous quantities of arms they carried stayed with them on the frontier of the empire.
tactics: 關於這場戰役的陣形細節，可用的記載只剩零星數筆，具體部署只能據此還原。羅軍沿用晚期帝國的標準野戰序列：最前列是散兵與輕裝兵，任務是牽制與遮蔽；中列是主力重裝步兵，盾牆緊密，隊形靠軍官號令和旗幟維持；後列是預備隊與工程器材。弩砲配置在步兵縱列的兩翼與陣地中央的空隙之內，發射前先以校準射擊測定聯軍的密集位置，再集中齊射，弩矢穿過前排的盾牌與身體，把聯軍的衝鋒隊形打散；等敵人逼近到弩砲難以再射的距離之後，弩砲即退入步兵陣內，由後方的輕步兵掩護撤回。騎兵分置兩翼，不與正面纏鬥，待聯軍隊形出現缺口才由側翼衝入。聯軍的戰法是典型的集群攻擊：先以密集長矛陣緩慢推進，用吼聲與鼓點維持節奏，靠人數與速度衝擊羅軍的側翼缺口；節奏一旦被打斷，龐大的人堆便會自行潰散。羅軍正是利用阿奎萊亞以南山地與沼澤交錯的地形，把聯軍的人數優勢切割成數段，再各個擊破；戰役結束後羅軍沒有追擊潰兵，而是就地設營，鞏固河渡與糧道。
tacticsEn: Only a few scattered notes survive on the formations used in this battle, and the actual deployment can only be reconstructed from them. The Romans followed the standard late imperial order of battle: in front, skirmishers and light troops whose task was to contain and screen; in the centre, the mass of armoured infantry, its shield wall close and its ranks held together by the officers signals and the unit standards; behind them, the reserve and the engineers. The bolt throwers were posted in the flanks of the infantry columns and in the gaps inside the line, and before firing they took careful calibration shots to fix the massed position of the coalition, after which they fired in concentration, the bolts passing through the shields and bodies of the front rank and breaking up the shape of the charge. Once the enemy had come close enough to spoil further shooting, the engines withdrew into the infantry line and were covered back by the light troops behind. The cavalry was posted on both wings and did not engage in the front; it struck in from the side only once a gap had opened in the coalition line. The coalition method was the typical barbarian mass attack: a slow advance in a dense spear wall, the rhythm kept up by shouting and by the beating of drums, relying on numbers and speed to hit the flanks of the Roman line. Once the rhythm was broken the great heap of men dissolved on its own. The Romans used the broken ground of hills and marshes south of Aquileia to cut the coalition numbers into separate blocks and destroy them one at a time; when the action was over they did not pursue the fugitives but encamped on the spot to secure the river crossings and the supply road.
data: 這場戰役可核實的數字不多，而且多有誇大成分，須分別看待。時間線上，聯軍自 431 年下半年已在諾里庫姆與雷蒂亞一線劫掠，432 年越過阿爾卑斯山口進入義大利並圍困阿奎萊亞，決定性的會戰置於同年夏末至初秋，具體日數各書未詳，一般編年採用 8 月。羅軍在多瑙河一帶建造的船隊，史料記載約有一百九十艘至二百餘艘，用於載運部隊與糧秣渡河；431 年末被押抵羅馬的阿勒曼尼王與法蘭克王，則是這位皇帝此前在萊茵線的戰果。戰後史家記羅軍俘獲聯軍首領父子，並記有約八萬名俘虜，這個數字顯係放大，較可信的估計是數萬人。距離方面，亞里米嫩至阿奎萊亞約二百五十公里，聯軍越嶺南下走的是薩瓦河與亞平寧山北麓的通道；羅軍由高盧調兵北上，單程數百公里，其後勤線在潘諾尼亞一段最為脆弱。糧秣靠高盧與北非供應的麥、穀、酒、油與隨軍輜重車隊維持，冬營與渡河器材是另外兩項吃重的消耗。武器方面，弩砲的弩矢重約數十磅，車載型可達百磅以上，但沒有任何一件兵器實物能對應到 432 年這一戰。
dataEn: The verifiable figures for this battle are few and several of them are exaggerated, so they have to be taken one by one. On the timeline, the coalition was already raiding along the Noricum and Raetia frontier in the second half of 431; in 432 it crossed the Alpine passes into Italy and besieged Aquileia; the decisive engagement is placed in the late summer or early autumn of the same year, and no source gives the exact day, though general chronologies settle on August. The fleet the Romans built on the Danube is recorded at somewhere between a hundred and ninety and a little over two hundred vessels, used to carry troops and grain across the river; the Alamannic king and the Frankish king brought to Rome at the end of 431 were the fruit of the emperor earlier victories on the Rhine. After the battle the historians record that the Romans captured the chiefs, father and son, and they give a figure of about eighty thousand prisoners, a number that is plainly inflated; a more credible estimate is several tens of thousands. As for distances, Ariminum lies about two hundred and fifty kilometres from Aquileia, and the coalition came over the mountains by way of the Sava and the northern foot of the Apennines; the Romans drew troops north out of Gaul, several hundred kilometres each way, and their supply line was at its most fragile across the Pannonian stretch. The army was fed on wheat, grain, wine and oil from Gaul and North Africa together with its baggage trains, and winter quarters and the pontoon bridging were the two other heavy consumptions. As for the weapons, a bolt of the lighter engines weighed several tens of pounds and those of the cart-mounted type more than a hundred, but no surviving weapon can be tied to the fighting of 432.
cause: 衝突的根源在羅馬邊防體系的崩解。四世紀末，匈人西遷把整個東歐的日耳曼部落推向羅馬邊境，378 年阿德里安堡一役之後，帝國的野戰軍與邊防結構元氣大傷，406 年汪達爾人渡萊茵河進入高盧，帝國在萊茵、多瑙與多瑙河下游同時用兵，羅馬已無力再像早期帝國那樣逐個殲滅入侵者，只能靠僱傭兵、結盟與讓步換取喘息。431 至 432 年，赫魯利人聯合汪達爾人與格皮德人，藉著羅馬正全力應付萊茵方向的阿勒曼尼與法蘭克人的空隙，越過多瑙河與阿爾卑斯，把戰火直接帶到亞平寧北麓，阿奎萊亞一線的糧食與軍械倉儲成了首當其衝的目標。羅馬必須出手的理由有三：一是阿爾卑斯山口一旦敞開，義大利平原便無險可守；二是皇帝需要一場勝利來穩住自己被東方禁軍將領與加萊斯掣肘的地位；三是羅馬四十年來多次以同盟條款安插日耳曼部落的做法，在 432 年這一戰之前已經試過一次，一旦失敗，邊境只會更難守。雙方都明白，這一仗決定的是由誰來決定義大利北部的秩序。
causeEn: The roots of the conflict lay in the breakdown of the Roman frontier system. When the Huns moved west in the late fourth century they pushed the Germanic tribes of eastern Europe against the Roman border; after Adrianople in 378 the field army and the structure of the frontiers were badly shaken, and when the Vandals crossed the Rhine into Gaul in 406 the empire was fighting on the Rhine, the Danube and the lower Danube at once. Rome no longer had the strength to destroy each invader in turn as the early empire had, and could only buy breathing room with mercenaries, alliances and concessions. Between 431 and 432 the Heruli, joined by Vandals and Gepids, took advantage of the fact that the whole Roman effort was fixed on the Alamanni and the Franks along the Rhine, crossed the Danube and the Alps, and carried the war straight to the northern foot of the Apennines, where the granaries and the arsenal of the Aquileia line were the first prize in sight. The Romans had three reasons to strike: once the Alpine passes stood open there was no natural defence left for the Italian plain; the emperor needed a victory to shore up his own position against the military factions of the eastern court and against Callus; and the Roman habit of settling Germanic groups inside the empire under treaty had already been tried once before 432, and if it failed here the frontier would be harder to hold than ever. Both sides understood that this battle would decide who set the order of northern Italy.
impact: 這場戰役的實際後果，遠比它的戰果所暗示的更為複雜。羅馬贏得乾淨，卻沒有解決它真正要解決的問題：多瑙河上游的關口仍在聯盟手中，赫魯利與格皮德人此後以同盟者的身份被安置在帝國境內與邊境，反而取得羅馬的津貼、軍械與在帝國境內的活動權，日耳曼部落在羅曼世界內部的實力由此進一步坐大，五年之後他們在萊茵和多瑙方向再度集結時，用的正是同一套聯盟與雇傭的辦法。433 年初的凱旋與元老院為皇帝立像（據記是在圖拉真廣場），把這場勝利寫進了羅馬的官方記憶，成為四世紀末羅馬最後的輝煌場面之一，但它遮蔽不了西羅馬在萊茵與高盧方向的同步崩解，西帝國仍在 476 年滅亡，羅馬對高盧的控制自五世紀二三十年代起已名存實亡。技術與戰術層面上，這一戰確認羅馬野戰軍仍能以弩砲、盾牆與騎兵兩翼的組合壓制數量遠多於己方的集群式蠻軍，也確立了野戰軍配合工程兵與攻城器械作為標準出擊組合的地位，隨後數十年羅馬對匈人、對汪達爾人、對西哥特人用兵，基本都沿用同一套節奏。
impactEn: The real consequences of this campaign were far more complicated than its result suggests. Rome won cleanly, but it did not solve the problem that mattered: the passes on the upper Danube were still in the hands of the alliance, and the Heruli and the Gepids were afterwards settled inside the empire and on its borders as federates, thereby receiving Roman stipends, arms and the right to move within imperial territory; the power of the Germanic groups inside the Roman world grew accordingly, and when they gathered again on the Rhine and the Danube five years later they used the same mixture of alliance and employment. The triumph at the beginning of 433 and the statue the senate raised for the emperor, recorded as standing in the Forum of Trajan, wrote the victory into the official memory of Rome, and became one of the last bright scenes of the late fourth century, but it could not hide the simultaneous collapse of the western empire on the Rhine and in Gaul; the western empire still fell in 476, and Roman control of Gaul had been nominal since the twenties or thirties of the fifth century. At the level of technique and tactics the campaign confirmed that the Roman field army could still crush a barbarian mass far larger than itself with the combination of bolt throwers, shield wall and cavalry on the wings, and it fixed the field army backed by engineers and siege engines as the standard way to go on the offensive; the campaigns that Rome fought in the following decades against the Huns, the Vandals and the Visigoths followed much the same rhythm.
result: 會戰以羅馬的完勝告終。聯軍在開闊平原上被切斷成數段，密集的長矛陣被弩砲的齊射與重裝步兵的反衝打散，騎兵在兩翼合圍，潰兵在沼澤與山麓之間被分割追殺；赫魯利王弗拉基提烏斯與其長子阿吉斯勞斯一同被俘，另有大批聯軍成員淪為俘虜或散入山林，阿奎萊亞之圍因此解除，義大利北部的軍糧與軍械線重獲安全。皇帝沒有把俘虜全部屠殺或淪為奴隸，而是按晚期帝國的慣例分派到帝國各地屯墾、編入軍隊，這成為日耳曼人在羅曼世界內部權力結構的一部分，此後同盟者與帝國的關係再沒有回到純粹的敵對狀態。433 年初，君士坦丁二世在羅馬舉行凱旋禮，獲元老院授像立碑。這場勝利結束了 432 年的戰事，卻只是把西線的崩解推遲了數十年：聯盟本身並未解散，多瑙河下游的失守最終導致 476 年西羅馬的覆亡，而羅馬弩砲在這一天之後，也再沒有能單獨改寫歐洲局面的機會。
resultEn: The engagement ended in a complete Roman victory. The coalition was cut into separate blocks on the open plain, the dense spear wall was broken up by the concentrated fire of the bolt throwers and the counter-charge of the armoured infantry, the cavalry closed in from both wings, and the fugitives were hunted down in pieces among the marshes and the foothills. The Heruli king Flaccitheus and his elder son Argislaus were taken prisoner together, and a large part of the coalition was either captured or scattered into the hills, so that the siege of Aquileia was lifted and the grain and munition route through northern Italy was safe again. The emperor did not slaughter the captives or sell them into slavery, but distributed them as colonists and soldiers across the empire according to the custom of the late empire, and they became part of the power structure of the Germanic peoples inside the Roman world; from that point on the relation between the federates and the empire never returned to plain enmity. In the beginning of 433 Constantius II celebrated his triumph in Rome and was granted a statue and an inscription by the senate. The victory closed the fighting of 432, but it only postponed the collapse of the western line by several decades: the alliance itself was not dissolved, the loss of the lower Danube in the end led to the fall of the western empire in 476, and after this day the Roman bolt thrower had no further chance on its own to redraw the shape of Europe.
